sources.historical: Original Atlas POI-08/S08; DEP-03/04/05/31 and JOURNEY-11/12 are analytical/adaptation anchors already recorded in MISSION_GRAPH.
sources.proposal: All custody, reserve, transition, panic-door and transaction rules here are new SOH proposals. No production APIs, item IDs, source timers or Gold semantics.

state_spec.location: One of graph node IDs; respawn is ww_boundary, a local abstraction of safe arrival, not a chosen A1 bed or teleport escape.
state_spec.portable: maintenance/assay booleans; priming/protection/service_supplies nonnegative integers; cargo_free abstract capacity; carrying_specimen boolean.
state_spec.world: Graph receipts and records persist independently from carried inventory. power has three modes. blocked is a set of directed edges.
state_spec.custody: specimen_owner = sealed | player | bag:<id> | lost. Exactly one physical specimen; specimen_taken never resets. bags retain unique id, physical node and payload across repeated deaths.
state_spec.transaction: receipts maps operation UUID to committed outcome. before_commit interruption leaves original state untouched; after_commit interruption restores committed snapshot. Replaying UUID is a no-op including all debits.
state_spec.reserve: Explicit finite pre-owned inventory at ww_boundary; withdraw transfers, never creates. No automatic regeneration or barter from nothing.
state_spec.transit: Atomic graph edges do not represent continuous Hero position. Mid-edge switching/expiry must retain origin and destination plus geometry; cannot be proven by node model.

failure_trace: Enter collection legitimately and take unique specimen; receipt committed.
Die: all portable credentials, supplies and specimen transfer to bag:death-1 at ww_collection.
Respawn empty at ww_boundary; power fails; external reserve is empty.
Even allowing the old free public sign_out, no transition increases priming or protection. e16/e17 cannot be crossed. e19 is outward only; e21 reaches refuge but cannot enter collection.
Specimen remains in death-1. No route reaches bag. Optional location remains unrecoverable; the wider game is not gated by it.
full_loss_verdict: FAIL: universal recovery promise is not met. Unit3 analysis is complete with a concrete blocker, not a successful recovered specimen.

conditional_reserve.provenance: Already owned, deliberately stashed before expedition from ordinary external play. Availability NOT VERIFIED; this is a conditional counterfactual, not a free rescue grant or accepted economy.
conditional_reserve.verdict: PASS only in finite abstract model when that actual reserve exists, bag is intact and passages available. Same identity bag specimen returned; no replacement specimen.

obstruction.CE01: e18 blocked + power none + protection zero: e23/e06/e02 is now a structural escape.
obstruction.double_block: e18 and e23 blocked at annex: FAIL. Explicit counterexample, never silently unblocks.
obstruction.proposed_guard: Before admitting player or committing movable geometry/building/debris changes, verify a physically traversable unpowered exit, reserving door sweep and corridor width against placement/body blocking. Reject mutation BEFORE changing geometry if it removes last exit. Never claim this fixes a preexisting trapped save; reject invalid load as unsafe and retain original save for repair. Do not delete obstacles or teleport.
obstruction.native: NOT_PROVABLE: no authored geometry, hitbox or hazard-time data.

temporal_safety.required_inequality: For every reachable occupied position x, minimum legal egress time T(x) plus reaction/door margin must be less than remaining tolerable exposure/flood time H(x).
temporal_safety.zero_protection: If H(x)=0 and T(x)>0, physical safety FAIL even when graph route exists. Need passive protected standing/retreat volume or proven nonlethal transition grace, not invented seconds.
temporal_safety.mid_switch: Actor on an edge must be able to complete or retreat to a physically safe endpoint. Freeze a switch request before spending priming if that cannot be established; spontaneous power loss still requires passive egress proof.
temporal_safety.verdict: NOT_PROVABLE without native geometry; no graph PASS upgrades this.

transaction_rules.redundant: calibrate once; reissue/certify only while assay absent; sign_out only while maintenance absent; same-mode startup rejected. All rejections byte-preserve model state.
transaction_rules.loot: ordinary/residue/boss/sample receipts prevent repeat grants after reload. Sample grant changes owner sealed -> player; recovery transfers bag -> player, never invokes sample grant.
transaction_rules.death: Atomic all-carried-payload transfer to new bag id, then normal death respawn. Previously existing bags remain. Death before action commit sees old inventory; death after sees updated inventory. No partial state claimed safe.
transaction_rules.lost_bag: If marker is lost but bag remains, re-find physical bag by known room; no remote pickup. If bag record or geometry location is actually destroyed/unreachable, FAIL recovery; receipt stays spent. No fabricated restoration.

bounded_tests.escape_product: All 11 node locations x 3 power modes x 2 maintenance x 2 assay x 2 protection (0/2) x 2 priming (0/1) x 4 obstruction sets (none/e18/e23/both). Movement reachability only; count passes and failures, not assume all pass.
bounded_tests.rescue_search: BFS all enabled graph actions/edges from full-loss respawn with empty finite reserve, receipt flags fixed, no supplied items. Conservative upper bound even permits free sign_out and successful boss action; still cannot power/protect entry. No depth cutoff.
bounded_tests.interruptions: before/after commit + reload + repeated UUID; death before/after specimen commit; bag retrieval repeated; power loss during request; finite reserve withdrawn twice.
bounded_tests.exclusions: Not all continuous states, arbitrary crashes, physics, enemies or economy. Explicit finite subsets only.

owner_decision.owner: Control Tower design review; A0/A1/A3 consulted only if adoption is later requested
owner_decision.requested: Choose deliberate optional specimen-loss policy OR approve an actually obtainable finite external replacement/reserve contract and conditions of its exhaustion. No universal recovery claim with zero remaining resources. Do not start Unit4 on this blocked design.
owner_decision.next_atomic_action: Review P0 failure and choose recovery/loss policy; then amend only the selected rescue preconditions and rerun this validator.

claims.reason: priming and protection cannot increase outside bag; collection unreachable
No conserved physical item recoverable; receipt not reset
Atomic JSON snapshots, repeated UUID and fresh redundant actions; not a real SaveService crash test
For every reachable occupied position x, minimum legal egress time T(x) plus reaction/door margin must be less than remaining tolerable exposure/flood time H(x).

escape_enumeration.scope: Fixed state movement-only reachability (no time/debit along route). Failures retained, not suppressed.

executed_results.exit_semantics: Exit 0 means oracle expectations passed INCLUDING expected FAIL counterexamples; never means universal recovery PASS.
